values: 召唤暴风雪降低对方急速并造成持续伤害。
Alna summons a blizzard to reduce enemies' Haste and deal damage over time.

战斗开始时，寒冬伴随阿尔娜降临战场，降低除阿尔娜外的所有单位40急速和2格射程。
主动释放时，阿尔娜发出战吼引发暴风雪，暴风雪将清空所有敌人的急速增益且每0.5秒对全场敌人造成40% + 6% ATK伤害，持续8秒。在此期间，暴风雪将暂时屏蔽自身和“凛冬战士”的痛觉，当其受到伤害时，会在后续10秒内逐渐恢复本次失去的50% + 5%生命值。

Passive. When a battle starts, Alna blankets the battlefield in frost, reducing Haste by 40 and range by 2 tiles for all units except herself.
Active. Alna lets out a battle cry and summons a blizzard, which removes the Haste buffs from all enemies and deals 40% + 6% ATK damage to each enemy every 0.5s for 8s. While the blizzard is active, when Alna or the Winter Warrior takes damage, they recover 50% + 5% of the HP lost from that damage over the next 10s.
造成的伤害提升至45% + 6% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 45% + 6% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至50% + 6% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 50% + 6% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至55% + 6% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 55% + 6% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至60% + 6% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 60% + 6% ATK.
任命“凛冬战士”并使其获得增益。
Alna appoints a Winter Warrior and grants them buffs.

布阵时与阿尔娜处于同排的一名友军将晋升为“凛冬战士”，“凛冬战士”免疫“凛冬战歌”带来的急速减益效果，并且永久提高15% + 1.5%生命上限。
主动释放时，阿尔娜使用长矛穿刺敌人造成340% + 40% ATK伤害，并为自己和“凛冬战士”恢复伤害量100% + 10%的生命。

During battle preparation, Alna selects an ally placed in the same row as herself to become the Winter Warrior. That ally is immune to Winter Anthem's Haste reduction effect, and their max HP is permanently increased by 15% + 1.5%.
Active. Alna thrusts her spear to deal 340% + 40% ATK damage to enemies, restoring 100% + 10% HP to herself and the Winter Warrior.
造成的伤害提升至360% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 360% + 40% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至380% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 380% + 40% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至400% + 40% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 400% + 40% ATK.
挥动长矛对周围敌人造成伤害，并降低目标急速。
Alna sweeps her spear, dealing damage to nearby enemies and reducing their Haste.
连续挥动长矛，对1格扇形范围内的敌人造成2次120% + 15% ATK伤害，随后横扫周围1格范围内的所有敌人造成240% + 30% ATK伤害，并降低敌人-50点急速，持续8秒。

Alna repeatedly swings her spear, striking enemies within a 1-tile arc in front of her twice, with each hit dealing 120% + 15% ATK damage. She then sweeps her spear around, dealing 240% + 30% ATK damage to all surrounding enemies and reducing their Haste by -50 for 8s.
前两段攻击造成的伤害提升至130% + 15% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至260% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 130% + 15% ATK, and the final strike to 260% + 30% ATK.
前两段攻击造成的伤害提升至140% + 15% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至280% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 140% + 15% ATK, and the final strike to 280% + 30% ATK.
前两段攻击造成的伤害提升至150% + 15% ATK，最后一击造成的伤害提升至300% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage of the first 2 strikes to 150% + 15% ATK, and the final strike to 300% + 30% ATK.
降低自身受到的伤害，随着战斗时间延长额外降低自身受到的伤害。
Reduces damage taken; damage reduction increases as the battle continues.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害降低10%，战斗每持续10秒，额外提升5%减伤，至多叠加5层。
Reduces damage taken by 10% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害降低14%，战斗每持续10秒，额外提升6%减伤，至多叠加5层。
Reduces damage taken by 14% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times.
战斗中，自身受到的伤害降低18%，战斗每持续10秒，额外提升7%减伤，至多叠加5层。
Reduces damage taken by 18% during battle. For every 10s the battle lasts, the damage reduction increases by 7%, stacking up to 5 times.
呼唤寒风的保护，进入无敌和免控状态。
Alna calls upon the protection of icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects.
战斗开始时和后续每隔20秒，阿尔娜呼唤寒风环绕保护自身，使自身免疫伤害与控制效果，持续4秒。
When a battle starts and every 20s thereafter, Alna envelops herself in icy winds, becoming immune to damage and control effects for 4s.
免疫伤害与控制效果的持续时间提升至5。
Extends this skill's damage and control immunity to 5s.
免疫伤害与控制效果的持续时间提升至6。
Extends this skill's damage and control immunity to 6s.
主动释放“摄人寒意”时的效果将同样对“凛冬战士”生效，当阿尔娜或“凛冬战士”的生命值首次低于50%时，将会额外触发一次“摄人寒意”，该效果每人每场战斗中最多触发1次。

After casting Chilling Presence, Alna also grants the Winter Warrior the same immunity effects. The first time either Alna's or the Winter Warrior's HP drops below 50% in battle, Chilling Presence triggers automatically for both. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per hero per battle.
阿尔娜和“凛冬战士”获得属性增益，退出"摄人寒意"状态时冻结敌人。
Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a stat buff. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warrior freezes nearby enemies.
阿尔娜和“凛冬战士”的基础属性提升15%，持续至其中任意一方被击败。首次退出"摄人寒意"状态时，冻结周围1格敌人，持续2秒，并降低目标-50点受愈，持续10秒。

Alna and her Winter Warrior gain a 15% increase to their basic stats until one of them is defeated. The first time either of them leaves the Chilling Presence state, Alna or the Winter Warrior will freeze enemies within 1 tile for 2s and reduce those enemies' Vitality by -50 for 10s.
